description: Shelly BLU Motion ZB の保存された検出イベント数。最小5分、長い表示期間では集計幅を自動調整。解除と初期状態を除外。記録開始前は表示しません。0回は保存イベントなしを示し、未受信区間での実際の動きを保証しません。

targets.rawSql:
WITH first_observation AS (
  SELECT min(observed_at) AS ts
  FROM sensor_motion_events
  WHERE mac = 'fc:4d:6a:26:53:e3'
), buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    greatest(time_bucket(greatest('$__interval'::interval, interval '5 minutes'), $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), time_bucket(greatest('$__interval'::interval, interval '5 minutes'), ts)),
    time_bucket(greatest('$__interval'::interval, interval '5 minutes'), $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
    greatest('$__interval'::interval, interval '5 minutes')
  ) AS bucket
  FROM first_observation WHERE ts IS NOT NULL
), detections AS (
  SELECT time_bucket(greatest('$__interval'::interval, interval '5 minutes'), observed_at) AS bucket, count(*) AS value
  FROM sensor_motion_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at)
    AND mac = 'fc:4d:6a:26:53:e3'
    AND motion = true AND initial = false
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT b.bucket AS "time", coalesce(d.value, 0)::bigint AS "Shelly Motion"
FROM buckets b LEFT JOIN detections d USING (bucket)
ORDER BY 1

title: 人感センサー 検知回数

description: Shelly BLU Motion ZB の電池残量（%）。期間に応じて分・1時間・12時間・1日集計を切り替えます。直近1日以上は分データを使い、長期集計の更新待ちによる最新値の欠落を防ぎます。

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS span,
    CASE
      WHEN ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) <= interval '30 days'
        THEN time_bucket('1 hour', now() - interval '1 day')
      WHEN ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) <= interval '90 days'
        THEN time_bucket('12 hours', now() - interval '1 day')
      ELSE time_bucket('1 day', now() - interval '1 day')
    END AS cutover
), readings AS (
SELECT sm.ts, sm.battery_percent AS value, 1 AS weight
FROM sensor_minute sm CROSS JOIN bounds b
WHERE $__timeFilter(sm.ts) AND sm.mac = 'fc:4d:6a:26:53:e3'
  AND sm.battery_percent IS NOT NULL AND (b.span <= interval '1 day' OR sm.ts >= b.cutover)
UNION ALL
SELECT sm.ts, sm.battery_percent AS value, sm.battery_percent_count AS weight
FROM sensor_1hour sm CROSS JOIN bounds b
WHERE $__timeFilter(sm.ts) AND sm.mac = 'fc:4d:6a:26:53:e3'
  AND sm.battery_percent IS NOT NULL AND b.span > interval '1 day' AND b.span <= interval '30 days' AND sm.ts < b.cutover
UNION ALL
SELECT sm.ts, sm.battery_percent AS value, sm.battery_percent_count AS weight
FROM sensor_12hour sm CROSS JOIN bounds b
WHERE $__timeFilter(sm.ts) AND sm.mac = 'fc:4d:6a:26:53:e3'
  AND sm.battery_percent IS NOT NULL AND b.span > interval '30 days' AND b.span <= interval '90 days' AND sm.ts < b.cutover
UNION ALL
SELECT sm.ts, sm.battery_percent AS value, sm.battery_percent_count AS weight
FROM sensor_1day sm CROSS JOIN bounds b
WHERE $__timeFilter(sm.ts) AND sm.mac = 'fc:4d:6a:26:53:e3'
  AND sm.battery_percent IS NOT NULL AND b.span > interval '90 days' AND sm.ts < b.cutover
)
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval'::interval, ts) AS "time",
  sum(value * weight) / NULLIF(sum(weight), 0) AS "Shelly Motion"
FROM readings
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

title: 人感センサー バッテリー残量
